description: Per-category broker_next_step and client_prep for insurance triage. Used when config present; falls back to triage hardcoded. Categories with dynamic client_prep or broker_next_step (missing_document, customer_question) keep logic in code.

cancellation_warning.broker_next_step: Confirm whether the cancellation is still active, verify any payment already made, and call or text the client today with the exact deadline.
cancellation_warning.client_prep: The cancellation notice, any payment confirmation, and the best callback number if they already paid.

payment_lapse_expiration.broker_next_step: Confirm whether the payment actually failed, check whether the carrier still shows the balance due, and help the client fix it today.
payment_lapse_expiration.client_prep: Updated payment method details, payment confirmation, or the best number to reach them today.

missing_document.broker_next_step: Verify whether customer-resubmitted items were received; request any still-missing items.

missing_signature.broker_next_step: Verify which document and which field still need a signature, then point the client to the exact page to sign.
missing_signature.client_prep: Confirmation of which document they signed and where.

underwriting_followup.broker_next_step: Confirm exactly what underwriting still needs, send the client a short checklist, and respond before the stated deadline.
underwriting_followup.client_prep: The missing underwriting details, questionnaire answers, or supporting documents requested before the deadline.

renewal_reminder.broker_next_step: Optional outreach for retention. No immediate action required.

unclear.broker_next_step: Ask for the missing part of the message so you can confirm whether this is routine, underwriting, or payment-related.
unclear.client_prep: Any additional context or the full original message if it was forwarded.

informational.broker_next_step: No action required. Optional brief confirmation to client.

policy_delay_pending.broker_next_step: No action needed right now. Keep the file parked and update the client if the carrier misses the stated timeline.

customer_requested_human.broker_next_step: Customer requested human contact. Call or message back promptly.
customer_requested_human.client_prep: Customer wants to speak with office.
